newsitem.title: USA: Clinton urges U.S. loans for growing DC deficit.
newsitem.headline: Clinton urges U.S. loans for growing DC deficit.

text.p: The Clinton Administration will ask Congress to allow the city to finance its accumulated $400 million to $500 million deficit through low interest rate loans from the Treasury Department, the White House announced Tuesday
The terms of the loans would be determined later, the White House said in a briefing paper on the Administration's $3.9 billion, five-year aid plan for the financially strapped city.
The District could refinance the Treasury loan at some later time after the District's credit picture improves, the White House said.
The District currently has a junk bond rating from major U.S. rating agencies.
